title: TraceResult
description:
The merged verb's output union — one shape per mode.

Emitted as ``trace.output.json``; the runtime ``validate_output`` gate and
external consumers validate whichever mode's payload was returned against
this union.

FirstDivergence.description:
The earliest diverging ``(stage, atom)`` — leads the render and the result.

``atom`` is ``null`` for a STRUCTURAL divergence (a stage present on one side
only); ``kind`` names the semantics that parted (``exact`` / ``set-delta`` /
…) or ``"structural"``.

seq.description: The diverging stage's seq (null only for a degenerate stage).
seq.title: Seq

atom.description: The diverging atom name; null for a structural divergence.
atom.title: Atom

kind.description: The comparison semantics that parted, or 'structural'.
kind.title: Kind

detail.description: The factual one-line difference (never a verdict).
detail.title: Detail

FirstDivergence.title: trace-diff first divergence

TraceDiffResult.description: Result of overlaying two traces — facts, no verdicts.

trace_schema_version.description: The T1 record schema version the diff was computed against.
trace_schema_version.title: Trace Schema Version

clean.description: True when the two traces have NO divergence at any stage/atom.
clean.title: Clean

aligned.description: True when every stage matched on (stage, seq) — no structural divergence.
aligned.title: Aligned

tolerance_applied.description: Verbatim echo of the caller-owned tolerance (null when exact).
tolerance_applied.title: Tolerance Applied

first_divergence.description: The earliest diverging (stage, atom); null on a clean diff.

stages.description: One entry per aligned/structural position, in seq order: `{stage, seq, side, divergences: [{atom, kind, detail}]}` (side ∈ both | a_only | b_only).
stages.title: Stages

structural.description: Structural divergences (unmatched stages) in the T1 flag shape.
structural.title: Structural

render.description: Deterministic, self-describing markdown overlay (trusted-display; no verdicts).
render.title: Render

TraceDiffResult.title: trace-diff output

TraceEndpoint.description: One side's key echo + what the store held for it (absence disclosed).

present.description: False when the store held no trace for this key (disclosed).
present.title: Present

stage_count.description: Number of stage records read for this side.
stage_count.title: Stage Count

TraceEndpoint.title: trace-diff endpoint

TraceFeatureRow.description: One feature-lineage stage: the col_set delta versus the predecessor.

added.description: Columns present here, absent in the predecessor col_set.
added.title: Added

dropped.description: Columns present in the predecessor col_set, absent here.
dropped.title: Dropped

TraceFeatureRow.title: trace feature-lineage row

TraceFlag.description: One flag in the canonical finding shape (rendered verbatim, never interpreted).

rule.description: The flag rule name (the record's OWN word).
rule.title: Rule

detail.description: The flag detail (the record's OWN word).
detail.title: Detail

TraceFlag.title: trace flag

trace_schema_version.description: Bumped when the emitted node/edge shape changes incompatibly.
trace_schema_version.title: Trace Schema Version

scope.description: Whether the DAG was rooted at a campaign or a single run's lineage.
scope.title: Scope

format.description: `dag` includes edges + per-wave nodes; `flat` is the run list only; `dot` is the full dag plus a rendered Graphviz `dot` string.
format.title: Format

campaign_id.description: The campaign tag, when scope == 'campaign'; null for run scope.
campaign_id.title: Campaign Id

root.description: Node id of the DAG root (`campaign:<id>` or `run:<seed>`).
root.title: Root

signature.description: The provenance-manifest self-attesting signature for this campaign (64-hex). Campaign scope only — null for run scope.
signature.title: Signature

nodes.description: Heterogeneous nodes keyed by `kind`: a `campaign` node, one `run` node per run (carrying its provenance fingerprint + lifecycle status + timing), and one `wave` node per wave (dag format only).
nodes.title: Nodes

edges.description: Directed edges by `rel`: `member` (run→campaign membership), `derived-from` (run→parent run lineage via parent_run_ids), and `contains` (run→wave). Empty in `flat` format.
edges.title: Edges

dot.description: Graphviz DOT rendering of the DAG — populated only in `dot` format, null otherwise. Pipe it to `dot -Tsvg` to draw the graph.
dot.title: Dot

TraceRenderResult.description:
The four structured views + the self-describing header + the render string.

``present`` is False (and ``skipped`` carries the disclosure) when the
resolved scope has no recorded trace — an honest result, never an error.
``trace_sha`` is a FINGERPRINT over the records (the identity the trace joins
the trust chain by), ``""`` when absent.

scope_kind.description: The resolved trace store scope kind.
scope_kind.title: Scope Kind

scope_id.description: The resolved trace store scope id ('' when unresolved).
scope_id.title: Scope Id

present.description: Whether a trace was found for the resolved scope.
present.title: Present

skipped.description: Absence disclosure ('' when a trace is present).
skipped.title: Skipped

stage_count.description: Number of records in the trace.
stage_count.title: Stage Count

trace_sha.description: Canonical sha over the records ('' when absent).
trace_sha.title: Trace Sha

header.description: Self-describing run/config identity from the sidecar join.
header.title: Header

label_chains.description: View (b): per tracked label, its 'stage=value' chain across stages.
label_chains.title: Label Chains

feature_births.description: View (c): each column mapped to its birth stage.
feature_births.title: Feature Births

flags.description: All flags (generic invariants + record-carried), rendered verbatim.
flags.title: Flags

render.description: The code-rendered markdown views ('' when not requested).
render.title: Render

TraceRenderResult.title: trace-render output data

TraceSketchRow.description: One (stage, column) sketch cell: null_count + the fixed value_sketch fields.

column.description: The column the sketch/null_count is for.
column.title: Column

TraceSketchRow.title: trace sketch row

TraceWaterfallRow.description: One row-waterfall stage: rows in/out + declared drops + conservation arithmetic.

rows_in.description: Predecessor stage's row_count.rows, or null at the head.
rows_in.title: Rows In

expected.description: rows_in - dropped (the conservation pre-image), or null.
expected.title: Expected

TraceWaterfallRow.title: trace waterfall row
